BiblicalUsage: Geshem is a person named 4 times in Scripture, in Nehemiah. The full story lives on the Geshem profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Geshem matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
